definitions.explanation: Previously owned or used; not new.

examples.japanese: {中古|ちゅうこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{中古|ちゅうこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{売|う}って→売る：00906_uru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
{中古|ちゅうこ}⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欲|ほ}しい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧。
examples.english: I want a cheap computer, even if it's used.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- {中古|ちゅうこ}: Used, secondhand (standard term for pre-owned goods)
- ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧: Old (general adjective, not specifically 'used')
- ⟦お{古|ふる}→お古：noentry⟧: Hand-me-down (especially clothes passed to younger siblings)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中古|ちゅうこ}⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧/⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧ (used car)
- {中古|ちゅうこ}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (used goods, secondhand items)
- {中古|ちゅうこ}⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧ (pre-owned apartment/condo)
- {中古|ちゅうこ}⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧ (pre-owned house)

USAGE:
{中古|ちゅうこ} is neutral and commonly used in commerce. For something very old or antique, ⟦{骨董品|こっとうひん}→骨董品：06990_kottouhin⟧ is used instead.
